ValidationRule.description: Service Line is required before an Opportunity can be moved to the "Propose" or "Contract" Stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( HasOpportunityLineItem = FALSE, ISCHANGED( StageName ), OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Propose' ), ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Contract' )), NOT( $Permission.BypassValidationRules ), NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: "Service Line" is required before this Opportunity can be moved to the "Propose" or "Contract" Stage
